p1.original: 这本书是“当代心理学的形象与声音”、著名心理学家菲利普·津巴多代表作的最新版，作为经典的心理学教材，本书包含了14个心理学入门需要学习的主题，包括心智、生物心理学、感觉与知觉、学习、记忆、思维与智力、毕生发展、意识状态、动机与情绪、人格、社会心理学、心理障碍、心理障碍的治疗，以及从应激到健康和幸福等内容。
p1.en: The book is the latest edition of “The image and voice of contemporary psychology”, a classic psychological teaching material by a representative of a prominent psychologist, Philip Zimbado, and contains 14 introductory psychological subjects, including mental, biopsychological, sensory and cognitive, learning, memory, mental and intellectual, lifelong development, state of consciousness, motivation and emotion, personality, psychosocial, psychological and psychological impairment, and treatment from stress to health and well-being.

p2.original: 本书每章内容均由一个生活中常见的问题引出，并围绕该问题提出相关心理学领域中的核心概念，在回答问题的过程中帮助学习者建立起对该领域的认知。同时，本书还通过“心理学很有用”“试一试”“写一写”“批判性思维的应用”等版块加强了学习者在日常生活中对心理学知识的应用与深度思考。另外，与之前的版本相比，本书对各个心理学细分领域的新研究都做了大量更新，便于学习者和研究者对自身知识体系更新换代。
p2.en: Each chapter of the book is inspired by a question that is common to all life and about which the core concept of the field of psychology is presented, helping learners to build awareness of the field in the course of answering questions. The book also strengthens the use and depth of psychological knowledge in everyday life by learners through such sections as “Psychology is useful” and “Turn one” and “Application of critical thinking”. In addition, compared to previous editions, the book has substantially updated new studies in various areas of psychological breakdown, enabling learners and researchers to update their own knowledge systems.

p3.original: 本书适合高校与相关研究机构的心理学学习者与研究者使用，也适合所有心理学爱好者阅读、参考。
p3.en: The book is suitable for use by psychologists and researchers at universities and relevant research institutions, and for reading and reference by all psychological lovers.
